description:
Inspect a public domain across DNS, HTTP/HTTPS/TLS, email posture and AI-agent discovery surfaces, including robots.txt, llms.txt, OpenAPI, MCP, x402 and Agent Card availability.
USE WHEN: an agent needs a single-call observational check of a domain's surfaces or wants to compare with a previous state.
DO NOT USE WHEN: protocol validation, Agent Card/A2A validation, MCP compliance validation, security certification, or a consumption guarantee. **USE `domain_risk_trust_decision` FOR:** merchant/domain trust.
Operational behavior: no tool-specific auth or rate limit; remote surfaces may throttle requests.

domain.description: Bare public domain for consolidated domain health, DNS, TLS, and email-posture inspection; no protocol or path; localhost and IP literals are rejected.
domain.title: Domain

previous_state.description: Optional prior `new_state` returned by this product. Supplied statelessly by the caller; when provided, it is compared against the current observation to populate `changes`. Omit it for a baseline inspection with no change detection.
previous_state.title: Previous State

name: domain_agent_discovery_check

actions.description: Recommended remediation actions derived from detected issues. Each item includes a code and a human-readable action. The tool does not execute these actions; they are recommendations only.

changes.description: Material field-level differences between `previous_state` and the current observation. Each item names a changed field with its previous and current values. Empty when `previous_state` is omitted or no field differs. Requires `previous_state` to produce non-empty results.

current_state.description: Structured snapshot of the current observation: domain, DNS, health, email posture, and agent readiness. Identical to `new_state`. Compared against `previous_state` to produce `changes` when supplied. Not persisted server-side.

data_quality.description: Observation quality summary: checks requested, completed, and failed, plus coverage (complete or partial). Reflects partial failures and missing surfaces. Not a score or verdict.

email_posture.description: Observed email posture including MX, SPF, and DMARC.

evidence.description: Observed evidence from DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, and agent-discovery checks. Each item names a source, the observation timestamp, the observed value, and freshness. Contains live remote observations; does not guarantee proof or validation.

health.description: Observed domain health: DNS, HTTP, HTTPS, redirects, TLS, and latency.

issues.description: Detected issues from the inspection: unresolved DNS, unavailable HTTPS, missing SPF/DMARC, TLS expiring soon, or unavailable agent-discovery signals. Each item includes a code, severity, message, and evidence references. Empty when no issues are found. Not a safety or security verdict.

new_state.description: Current observation state, structured identically to `current_state`. Can be supplied as `previous_state` in a subsequent call to enable change detection. Not persisted server-side; the caller stores and passes it back.

observed_at.description: UTC timestamp when the inspection observation was generated, in ISO 8601 format with Z suffix. Reflects the local observation time, not a provider timestamp.

security_posture.description: Observed HTTPS/TLS security posture; not a safety verdict.

title: Domain & Agent Discovery Check
